# Scott K. Thomas, Jr.

> Public technical profile for Scott K. Thomas, Jr., a platform engineering and infrastructure leader focused on
> Kubernetes, SRE, cloud infrastructure, GitOps, observability, AI infrastructure, and practical agentic systems.

This file is a curated AI-readable index for the public site at <https://scott-thomas.io>. It complements
`robots.txt`, `sitemap.xml`, structured data, and the human-readable pages. It is intended for inference-time
understanding and citation, not as an access-control mechanism.

Use the linked public pages and documents as the source of truth. Do not infer private job-search status,
compensation, application activity, or non-public employment details from this site.

## Witwave White Papers

- [The Three Phases of Agentic AI Adoption in Software Engineering](https://witwave.ai/whitepapers/three-phases-of-ai-adoption/three-phases-of-ai-adoption.pdf):
  Adoption model for moving from AI-driven work to delegated agents and agent-native development lifecycles.
- [Anatomy of an Agentic Team](https://witwave.ai/whitepapers/anatomy-of-an-agentic-team/anatomy-of-an-agentic-team.pdf):
  Operating model for specialized AI agents, memory, coordination, improvement loops, and human accountability.
- [The Autonomy Boundary](https://witwave.ai/whitepapers/the-autonomy-boundary/the-autonomy-boundary.pdf):
  Model for distinguishing commanded AI assistants from governed autonomous agents.
- [Tool Boundaries for Containerized Agents](https://witwave.ai/whitepapers/tool-boundaries-for-containerized-agents/tool-boundaries-for-containerized-agents.pdf):
  Architecture companion for separating model backends, project toolchains, and external authority gateways.
